notes.title: 关于TheParcel开发终止的通知
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We are sincerely apologize to all who have followed and supported our game "The Parcel". In June 2023, we announced on Twitter that development had ceased, but we have only now realized that we failed to formally notify our Steam community, an oversight for which we are truly sorry.

As a token of our gratitude for your support, we have released a free Demo version of "The Parcel". Although incomplete, we hope it brings you enjoyment and gives you a taste of our creative vision. You are warmly invited to download and experience the Demo.

Please note that the Demo is still in development and may contain some bugs, such as:

Dialogue text may not load when the language is set to English or Chinese.
The English translation has not been proofread and may contain many errors.
The game may become unplayable if key items are damaged during transport.
Character models may display incorrectly when jumping and moving in the opposite direction.
We are acutely aware of the impact these issues may have on your gameplay experience and offer our deepest apologies. While development on "The Parcel" has ceased, we still welcome and encourage you to try out the Demo. Furthermore, we hope you look forward to our new project "Kaiju Cracking Corp" with anticipation.

Once again, we apologize for the incompleteness of "The Parcel" and any inconvenience it may have caused. We are truly grateful for your understanding and support.

Sincerely,
dot.Studio
